# Kiez & Key

> Kiez & Key is a Berlin relocation and rental agency. We find hand-picked new builds, lofts and houses in Berlin's best neighbourhoods for newcomers, explain German rental contracts in English and help with the Anmeldung.

## Pages
- [Home](https://kiezandkey.de/): homes available now, how it works, neighbourhoods (Mitte, Charlottenburg, Grunewald, Prenzlauer Berg), client reviews, FAQ and contact
